description: JVMALIN lignes bus et cars is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by JVMALIN. Lignes de transport en bus urbain et cars interurbain des partenaires JVMALIN en région Centre Val de Loire. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport, Cars, jvmalin, bus. The portal shows 678 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
